copy.headline: Help Your Teen Land a Dog Walking Client This Week
copy.body: Have your teen write a simple note: 'Hi, I'm [Name], your neighbor. I walk dogs for $15/walk. Text me anytime.' Print 10 copies and walk the block together Saturday morning.
